environment.google: GIS and Drive network mocked; VistaTeacher app APIs and Storage real emulators

browser.methodology: 42 retained passing cases plus 2 focused completed-scroll checks; not a single clean 44-case run.

lint.scope: All src plus changed rules/browser tests, Vitest rules and Next config

format.scope: All src plus changed tests/config/docs, preserving existing line endings

accessibility.scope: Selected Axe WCAG A/AA diagnostics and visible enabled 44px button measurements; not a complete assistive-technology audit

limitations: Real OpenAI quality, output-language adherence, latency and token spend remain unverified.
Real Google authorization, private sharing, conversion and multilingual PDF shaping remain unverified.
Lesson resource synchronization and direct delivery still need persistent moderation enforcement.
Printable lesson headings remain English; units and presentations remain later phases.
Same-tab reload recovery uses sessionStorage; closing the tab ends client request recovery. Saved content remains on the server. No scheduled recovery worker or retention policy.
Legacy jobs without debit records cannot safely receive automatic quota refunds.
Firebase App Hosting/Storage require Blaze; no billing-plan or production configuration was changed.
The $25/month OpenAI pilot ceiling is recorded but not yet enforced by application controls. No provider account spending settings were changed.
The configured GPT-4.1 mini is deprecated and scheduled for shutdown on January 14, 2027; a supported replacement requires quality/cost evaluation.
Incomplete legacy private-profile records still need graceful recovery without resetting privacy or deletion state.
Transient stacked toasts can obscure dialog headings and navigation; settled screenshots do not establish that this overlap is fixed.

A rapid Page Down/Home sequence once failed in mobile Chromium. Native isolated checks and the original app sequence later passed; no application cause was proven. Final keyboard checks wait for Page Down to finish before Home and do not prove rapid opposing-key behavior.

browserRuns.note: The initial full run had one mobile Home-key assertion failure. Both desktop/mobile instances of that history scenario are replaced by the focused completed-scroll checks below.
History scenario on both projects, after waiting for Page Down scrollend before pressing Home. Runtime inputs match the same pinned build.

methodology.localMetadataDetection: METADATA_SERVER_DETECTION=none for the final demo app/browser run; external cloud-runtime detection is unnecessary for local emulators.
methodology.browserTiming: An initial community journey hit its overall 30-second deadline. Timing diagnostics showed progress through the flow. Final full-journey limit is 90 seconds for creation flows, with 15-second action limits, 30-second navigation limits, default 5-second assertions and no retries.
methodology.unitFixture: Worksheet answer-review tests use the question type they edit, keeping the recovery and review assertions without rendering unrelated question types. No unit timeout was raised.
methodology.discardedRun: An earlier rules run lost Auth/Storage after an external temporary directory disappeared. It was discarded. The final 72 checks used a fresh stack with Storage temporary files inside the workspace.
methodology.baseline: Two pre-fix screenshots and the failing history keyboard-accessibility baseline are preserved in lesson-reliability-before/verification.json.
methodology.dimensions: PNG dimensions record bitmap pixels. Mobile emulation uses a device pixel ratio; these are not CSS viewport dimensions.
methodology.screenshots: Lesson screenshots wait for transient Sonner notifications to dismiss through their normal timer; no DOM elements are hidden or removed for capture.
methodology.browserFixtures: Earlier one-shot interception intermittently stalled a ledger GET before network dispatch in mobile Chromium. Persistent first-POST failure handlers remove that test-routing race; this is an inference from traces, not a verified production backend defect. The regression also independently verifies that an unresolved usage-display refresh does not keep generation locked.
methodology.securityChecks: 72 checks passed before the shell and client-refresh fixes. The backend, schemas, rules and indexes have identical fingerprints; these checks were not repeated against UI-only changes.
methodology.nonFatalUnitDiagnostic: The full unit log includes the existing JSDOM Window.scrollTo not-implemented diagnostic; all 323 tests passed and the runner exited successfully.
methodology.localRestart: The audit resumed with no old server/emulator processes. The same pinned build was restarted, demo data was reseeded and the focused keyboard checks ran against it. tsx could not call os.userInfo in the managed environment; the current tracked seed was transpiled with TypeScript and run as JavaScript.
